text: Let ‘em have that deed. Go and fetch it!’ ‘Do you help her, Mr. Dick,’ said Traddles, ‘if you please.’ Proud of his commission, and understanding it, Mr. Dick accompanied her as a shepherd’s dog might accompany a sheep. But, Mrs. Heep gave him little trouble; for she not only returned with the deed, but with the box in which it was, where we found a banker’s book and some other papers that were afterwards serviceable. ‘Good!’ said Traddles, when this was brought. ‘Now, Mr. Heep, you can retire to think: particularly observing, if you please, that I declare to you, on the part of all present, that there is only one thing to be done; that it is what I have explained; and that it must be done without delay.’ Uriah, without lifting his eyes from the ground, shuffled across the room with his hand to his chin, and pausing at the door, said: ‘Copperfield, I have always hated you.
